metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about changes in tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai between two specific time periods in 2020. This is a clear air quality analysis question. 1. Data Strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for NO2 measurements - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Shanghai region (define polygon around Shanghai) 2. Processing Strategy: - Get mean NO2 values for each period - Compare the two means to see if there was an increase - Need to check for valid data and handle edge cases 3. Validation: - Check collection sizes for both periods - Check pixel counts after processing - Validate the numerical results Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Shanghai region var shanghai = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[120.85, 30.67], [121.97, 30.67], [121.97, 31.53], [120.85, 31.53], [120.85, 30.67]] ]); // Define time periods var period1_start = '2020-02-10'; var period1_end = '2020-02-25'; var period2_start = '2020-04-20'; var period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // Get NO2 collections var no2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(shanghai) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); var no2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(shanghai) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes var size1 = no2_col1.size().getInfo(); var size2 = no2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr-May) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites var mean1 = no2_col1.mean(); var mean2 = no2_col2.mean(); // Calculate mean NO2 values var result1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); var result2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check pixel counts var count1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); var count2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); var val1 = result1.getInfo(); var val2 = result2.getInfo(); var pix1 = count1.getInfo(); var pix2 = count2.getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 NO2: ${val1 ? val1.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${pix1}`); console.log(`Period 2 NO2: ${val2 ? val2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${pix2}`); // Validation checks if (pix1 === 0 || pix2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check for valid range (NO2 should be positive and reasonable) if (val1 < 0 || val2 < 0 || val1 > 1e-3 || val2 > 1e-3) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Determine if there was an increase if (val2 > val1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
